title: Grandma, it's me - I'm in hospital
scenario: A voice that sounds exactly like your grandson calls, crying, saying he was in an accident and needs money for a hospital deposit before they'll treat him. He begs you not to call his parents.

answers.A: Ask him a question only the real grandson would know, then decide what to do.
answers.B: Wire the deposit right away since he sounds so upset.
answers.C: Hang up and call your grandson or his parents directly on a number you already have.

explanation: AI voice cloning can now copy a familiar voice from a few seconds of audio. A voice matching isn't proof of identity anymore - a callback on a known number is.
proTip: The voice can be faked. The number you already have for them can't.
